prisoners.name: Darializa Avila Chevalier
prisoners.description: Darializa Avila Chevalier is a pro-Palestinian activist and congressional candidate. Police arrested her on September 24, 2026, during a sit-in blocking First Avenue near United Nations headquarters in New York City. The demonstrators opposed Benjamin Netanyahu’s visit and U.S. support for Israel’s war in Gaza.

cases.sentence: Released; no sentence established.
